question: Should exact proposal previews and proposal-version binding become a permanent core `skill_workshop` tool contract?
rationale: This adds new model-facing capability and changes how pending lifecycle approvals behave after proposal revision, but the PR discussion contains no maintainer decision accepting that product and compatibility direction.

options.title: Adopt the core contract
options.body: Accept exact review and version binding as supported behavior, then require real-flow and upgrade proof before landing.

options.title: Enhance inspect only
options.body: Expose more proposal detail without adding a separate review action or version-bound lifecycle protocol.

options.title: Keep summary approvals
options.body: Decline the new capability and close this PR together with the paired feature issue.

recommendation.title: Adopt the core contract
recommendation.body: Accept exact review and version binding as supported behavior, then require real-flow and upgrade proof before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged current Skill Workshop implementation this PR extends.
